title: Facilities Manager
summary: Lead day-to-day facility operations, vendor coordination, and workplace readiness for a multi-site portfolio.
description: CAISBE partner opportunity for an experienced facilities manager. Responsibilities include preventive maintenance planning, contractor oversight, health and safety compliance, and continuous improvement of building performance.

title: Building Operations Supervisor
summary: Supervise building systems, maintenance technicians, and service quality across commercial facilities.
description: Coordinate HVAC, electrical, and soft services teams. Track work orders, manage emergency response, and report on asset condition for leadership.

title: Property & Facilities Coordinator
summary: Support property inspections, space planning, and facilities administration for growing workplace teams.
description: Ideal for early-career FM professionals. Assist with vendor scheduling, occupancy updates, sustainability checklists, and stakeholder communications.

title: Senior Facility Engineer
summary: Own critical building systems engineering, energy efficiency projects, and technical standards.
description: Lead capital project scoping for plant upgrades, review technical proposals, and mentor junior engineers while keeping facilities reliable and compliant.

title: Workplace Experience Manager
summary: Deliver a high-quality workplace experience spanning facilities, hospitality services, and employee support.
description: Partner with HR and operations to run reception services, event setups, service desk SLAs, and continuous feedback loops for workplace satisfaction.
